prompts.name: Penguin
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a single square app-launcher icon for Gaijin, a native Linux console on a handheld computer. Direction B: Penguin. An original friendly stylized penguin face: simple black cap, broad white cheek shapes, two clear eyes and a warm golden-yellow beak, centered on a deep navy rounded-square tile. Polished minimal pixel art with large bold shapes and a tightly controlled five-color palette. Designed for excellent readability as a 16-pixel launcher icon and matching 32- and 64-pixel exports. Make the face fill most of the tile; omit feet, body, feathers and small details. Transparent outer corners. No words, no labels, no letters, no presentation sheet, no gradients, no shadows, no glow. One icon only. Transparent background outside the tile.
